candidates.change_summary: Replace `return _owner;` with `return address(0);` so owner() always returns the zero address instead of the actual owner.
Replace `return _owner;` with `return msg.sender;` so owner() returns the caller instead of the stored owner.
Remove the zero-address check so ownership can be transferred to address(0).
Transfer ownership to the caller instead of the provided newOwner.
Invert the owner check so only non-owners may call guarded functions.
Remove the access check so any caller can invoke owner-guarded functions.
Removed the zero-address require check so roundImplementation can be set to address(0).
Inverted the zero-address check so calls revert unless the new implementation is the zero address.
Dropped the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can update roundImplementation.
Inserted a statement zeroing roundImplementation at the start of the function so it always ends up as address(0).
Removed the _checkOwner() call so the onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts callers.
